classdef.name: TransformPositionReference
classdef.shortdesc: Options for specifying the reference position for X and Y attributes of style. If set none, it will disable the attribute.

property.name: PAGE_EDGE_REFERENCE
property.shortdesc: Corresponding edge of the page. Left edge for X attribute, Top edge for Y attribute.

property.name: PAGE_MARGIN_REFERENCE
property.shortdesc: Corresponding page margin of the page. Left margin for X attribute, Top margin for Y attribute.
